Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Line ki doosri taraf 3 barabar gaps hain. Wahan 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Board par abhi sirf beech wala khamba hai. 3 khambe raaste ko kitne barabar gaps mein kaatte hain?
